title: Low-register spectrogram render spec v1 (xoruby V4)

golden.hash_note: the golden records this spec's spec_sha256; this spec does not record the golden hash (no circular hash)

spec_sha256_rule: sha256 of canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators (',',':'), ensure_ascii, no NaN) of this object without the spec_sha256 key

parameters.preprocessing: none: no DC removal, pre-emphasis, high-pass, notch or dither
parameters.other_rates: refused_exit_2; explicit external resample is a recorded caller pre-stage
parameters.frame_rule: frame t uses samples [160t, 160t+4096); n_frames = 1 + floor((N-4096)/160); N < 4096 refused
parameters.frame_centre_formula: (160t + 2048)/8000 seconds from the first analysed sample
parameters.magnitude_filterbank: not_part_of_v1; sqrt of band power is not a magnitude filterbank
parameters.filter_shape: triangle in Hz at f_j = 1.953125 j; left half-width L_k = max(f_k - f_k*2^(-1/24), 1.953125), right R_k = max(f_k*2^(1/24) - f_k, 1.953125); weight max(0, 1 - |f_j - f_k|/(L_k if f_j <= f_k else R_k))
parameters.band_energy_formula: E[t,k] = sum_j W[k,j] * P[t,j], ascending j

pcen.state: causal; smoother row M carried across frames and streamed blocks; block equals batch exactly

caveats: Below ~66.65 Hz (right side) / ~68.61 Hz (left side) a filter half-width is clamped to one 1.953125 Hz FFT bin; low bands are linear interpolation between adjacent FFT bins and are not independent measurements.
The Hann main lobe spans +/-3.9 Hz while a semitone at C1 is ~1.94 Hz: pitch_resolution_claim none; energy near 32.7 Hz is not C1 identification and a dominant peak is not a played note.

A 512 ms support contains ~16.7 C1 cycles but blurs a 178 BPM sixteenth (~84.27 ms) across ~6 subdivisions; the 20 ms hop samples a 512 ms-smoothed trajectory and is not 20 ms time resolution. The short-window attack branch stays separate and remains the source of onset/timing evidence.
Log-power D is the baseline of this branch and log-mel remains video-utils' baseline frontend; PCEN is experimental with fixed, untuned knobs fixed for reproducibility, not recommendation.
Values are window-normalized power samples on an uncalibrated digital scale, not dBFS or SPL; microphone response unknown.
Feature transform only: restores no audio, separates no stem, identifies no note; no 400 Hz or 80 Hz floor, no high-pass, no mains notch.

harmonic.formula: h[n] = e[n] * sum_{m=1..6} a_m sin(2 pi m f0 n / 8000)

fixture.container: RIFF WAVE PCM16 mono via stdlib wave, 44-byte header
